decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established, popular biodynamic range central to Söbbeke's organic identity, it is still communicated in its second year, and it shares production with existing yogurts, so it likely meets aspirations at low cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The mild sliced cheese was launched only in 2024 and has its own product page, so the firm is still investing in it, and an established mid-sized organic dairy has enough slack to carry a young product in a growing organic sliced-cheese segment while results remain uncertain.

The sliced butter cheese is a recent 2024 launch with its own page that complements the mild sliced cheese in the same format and production line, so dropping it after one year would be premature unless retail listings clearly fall short.
